facts.fact: The plan states that Government has embarked on a review of the National ICT Policy, alongside the 2021 cyber security policy and four 2021 Acts; no adoption of a revised policy is stated (dated by the plan's publication, 2023-08-17).

systems.owner: Ministry of Technology and Science (policy oversight of ICTs)
Electronic Government Division, Office of the President
Ministry of Finance and National Planning

note: The plan is a government-digitalisation strategy (class government); its only sector-class fact is the stated review of the National ICT Policy.
